title: 1.3.3 Sensory Characteristics Mini-assessment
description: Check your understanding of 1.3.3 Sensory Characteristics.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: Which instruction identifies a control without relying solely on its location?
choices: Select Continue, the button at the bottom
Select the button on the right
elements.correctAnswer: Select Continue, the button at the bottom
elements.feedback: The label Continue identifies the control independently of its location.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Why is “press the square button” insufficient as the only instruction?
elements.feedback: A person who cannot perceive shape needs another identifying cue.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Which related criterion addresses color as the only visual means of conveying information?
elements.feedback: 1.4.1 addresses use of color as the only visual means.
